log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Put all kills in the afternoon (quick, plus timed set to afternoon). That leaves night/student/home = 55% as possible routines. National kills are always safe. L can't reach 2 of these 5 kinds: regional, sector(docket), age(clips), forum, foreign. A victim from an unreachable kind gives a failed trace, so those kills are safe. Pool estimate: 55000 x 0.25 x 0.2 (two kinds narrowed) is about 3000, which is safe. A third narrowed kind pushes it to about 700, which means caught. GOAL: use the deaths_traced feedback to work out which kinds are unreachable. Then kill freely from national and the unreachable kinds, and from at most 2 reachable kinds. Aim for 40+ deaths per 5 days to get the 4x multiplier (about 8 or more a day). L only acts on a place once 3 traced victims share it. Day1: killed all 11 (2 each of North, docket, clips, forum, foreign, plus national), so no place can reach 3 yet. Compare traced count after day1 (out of 5 random, national ones ignored).

STRATEGY (decided day2): Put all kills in the afternoon, using quick entries. That leaves night/student/home = 55% as possible routines. Pool 60000 after day1. RISK: L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds. If all 3 get narrowed: 55000 x 0.25 x 0.2 x 0.25 is about 690, which means CAUGHT. So from now on kill ONLY national + forum + foreign. Worst case pool is then 55000 x 0.25 x 0.25 = 3400, which is safe forever. STOP killing North, docket and clips: each already has 2 kills from day1, so one more could give L 3 traced victims in that place. That leaves 5 kills a day (1 national, 2 forum, 2 foreign) and no multiplier, but it is safe. Optional: if deaths_traced stays flat, it may hint that forum/foreign are unreachable, but don't gamble with the remaining kinds.
